# M28C: retain logical interfaces while USB enumeration is changing.

# M28C: saved enabled/tty values are not proof of this boot's USB binding.
_m28c_mark_usb_pending() {
    local interface fixed state
    config_get interface "$1" data_interface
    config_get fixed "$1" fixed_device 0
    config_get state "$1" state
    [ "$interface" = "usb" ] && [ "$fixed" != "1" ] || return 0
    [ "$state" != "disabled" ] || return 0
    if ! uci -q set "qmodem.$1.state=disabled"; then
        m28c_pending_failed=1
        return 1
    fi
    m28c_pending_changed=1
}

start_service() {
	config_load qmodem
    config_get block_auto_probe main block_auto_probe 0
    if [ "$block_auto_probe" != "1" ]; then
        m28c_pending_changed=0
        m28c_pending_failed=0
        config_foreach _m28c_mark_usb_pending modem-device
        [ "$m28c_pending_failed" = "0" ] || return 1
        if [ "$m28c_pending_changed" = "1" ]; then
            uci commit qmodem || return 1
            config_load qmodem
        fi
    fi
    _start_scand

# M28C: a running dial process caches its ports; procd must see rebinding.
_m28c_binding()
{
    local path at_port network generation
    config_load qmodem
    config_get path "$1" path
    config_get at_port "$1" at_port
    config_get network "$1" network
    config_get generation "$1" m28c_usb_devnum
    printf '%s|%s|%s|%s' "$path" "$at_port" "$network" "$generation"
}

_update_modem()
{
    local target binding previous_binding

if [ "$current_status" = "1" ] && [ "$target" = "1" ]; then
        binding=$(_m28c_binding "$1")
        previous_binding=$(printf '%s\n' "$data" | jq -r '.env.QMODEM_BINDING // empty')
        if [ "$binding" != "$previous_binding" ]; then
            # Do not run hang with the newly assigned port: it may already dial.
            procd_kill "$service" "modem_$1"
            dial "$1"
            logger -t qmodem_network "Rebound modem $1 to current USB devices"
            return
        fi
    fi
    if [ "$current_status" != "$target" ];then

procd_set_param command "/usr/share/qmodem/modem_dial.sh" "$1" dial
    procd_set_param env QMODEM_BINDING="$(_m28c_binding "$1")"

local path state at_port interface real_path real_at
    path=$(uci -q get "qmodem.$1.path")
    state=$(uci -q get "qmodem.$1.state")
    # A removed device's tty number may now belong to another module.
    [ "$state" != "disabled" ] && [ -d "$path" ] || return 0
    interface=$(uci -q get "qmodem.$1.data_interface")
    if [ "$interface" = "usb" ]; then
        at_port=$(uci -q get "qmodem.$1.at_port")
        real_path=$(readlink -f "$path")
        real_at=$(readlink -f "/sys/class/tty/${at_port##*/}/device")
        [ -n "$real_path" ] && [ -n "$real_at" ] || return 0
        case "$real_at" in "$real_path"/*) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
    fi
    /usr/share/qmodem/modem_dial.sh "$1" hang

# M28C: never send recovery commands to a stale or reassigned tty.
modem_binding_ready(){
    local real_path real_at
    [ "$MODEM_STATE" = "enabled" ] || return 1
    [ "$MODEM_DIAL" != "0" ] && [ "$GLOBAL_DIAL" != "0" ] || return 1
    [ -n "$AT_PORT" ] && [ -d "$MODEM_PATH" ] || return 1
    if [ "$MODEM_INTERFACE" = "usb" ]; then
        real_path=$(readlink -f "$MODEM_PATH")
        real_at=$(readlink -f "/sys/class/tty/${AT_PORT##*/}/device")
        [ -n "$real_path" ] && [ -n "$real_at" ] || return 1
        case "$real_at" in "$real_path"/*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    fi
    return 0

# QMI/QMAP bearers may be online while AT+CGACT? still reports inactive.
# Accept only an addressed, up netifd interface physically belonging to this
# modem. Never infer its state from an unrelated WAN or a cached interface name.
m28c_netifd_connected()
{
    local modem_real devices device device_real
    [ -n "${modem_path:-}" ] && [ -d "$modem_path" ] || return 1
    modem_real=$(readlink -f "$modem_path") || return 1
    case "$modem_real" in /sys/devices/*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    devices=$(ubus call network.interface dump 2>/dev/null | jq -r '
        .interface[]? | select(.up == true) |
        select(any(."ipv4-address"[]?; .address != null and .address != "" and
                   .address != "0.0.0.0" and (.address | startswith("169.254.") | not)) or
               any(."ipv6-address"[]?; .address != null and .address != "" and
                   .address != "::" and (.address | ascii_downcase | startswith("fe8") or startswith("fe9") or startswith("fea") or startswith("feb") | not))) |
        .l3_device // .device // empty
    ') || return 1
    for device in $devices; do
        case "$device" in ''|*[!a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]*) continue ;; esac
        [ -d "/sys/class/net/$device/device" ] || continue
        device_real=$(readlink -f "/sys/class/net/$device/device") || continue
        case "$device_real" in "$modem_real"/*) return 0 ;; esac
    done
    return 1
}

get_connect_status()
{

if [ "$connect_status" != "Yes" ] && m28c_netifd_connected; then
        connect_status="Yes"
    fi
    add_plain_info_entry "connect_status" "$connect_status" "Connect Status"
